title: Disassemble Dell Latitude 7455 - Cover, Battery, SSD and Wi-Fi
summary: Open the Dell Latitude 7455 by removing the 7-screw bottom cover, disconnecting and removing the 54Wh battery, then accessing the 2230 SSD shield and Wi-Fi cover for inspection.
warnings: Power off and unplug the laptop before opening.
Disconnect the battery before touching other components.
Keep tiny screws sorted by size and location.

steps.title: Unscrew seven bottom cover screws
steps.instruction: Undo the seven Phillips-head screws around the bottom cover, leaving the two captive screws at the top edge in place.
warnings: Do not force the two captive screws out; they stay in the cover.

evidence.text: To open this this compact device you have to undo seven Phillips head screws.
Bottom of closed laptop showing screws around edge

steps.title: Pry off bottom cover
steps.instruction: Pry the sides and front with a thin plastic tool, release the back last, then lift the bottom cover off.
warnings: Use plastic tool only to avoid bending the thin cover or breaking clips.

evidence.text: Pry the sides and the front with a thin plastic tool the back should be last.
Blue plastic tool inserted along side and front edge of bottom cover

steps.title: Disconnect battery cable
steps.instruction: Unplug the battery connector from the main board.
warnings: Always disconnect battery first to avoid short circuit on the board.

evidence.text: this machine has a 54 watt hour battery to take it out unplug the connector from the main board

steps.title: Unscrew battery
steps.instruction: Undo the five Phillips-head screws securing the battery to the base.
steps.fastener_where: five points securing battery to base
warnings: Keep battery screws sorted; do not puncture the battery pack.

evidence.text: and undo the five Phillips head screws that secure the unit to the base.
Screwdriver turning screws securing black battery pack

steps.title: Remove battery
steps.instruction: Lift the 54Wh battery pack out of the chassis.
warnings: Lift by edges; do not bend the battery.

evidence.text: Hands lifting black Dell 54Wh battery pack out of chassis

steps.title: Inspect soldered memory
steps.instruction: Inspect the soldered LPDDR5X memory on the board.

evidence.text: The memory is solid. You get 16 or 32 gigabytes of LPDDR5X 8448 megahertz RAM.

steps.title: Unscrew SSD shield
steps.instruction: Undo the single screw holding the SSD metal plate.
steps.fastener_where: single screw on SSD metal plate
warnings: Hold the small shield to prevent it springing away.

evidence.text: For storage there is just one M.2 slot compatible with the shortest 2230 Gen 4 SSDs. The NVMe is covered covered by a metal plate that is held in place by a single screw.
Screwdriver on small metal SSD cover on right side of board

steps.title: Remove SSD shield
steps.instruction: Pull the SSD shroud forward and lift it off to expose the thermal pad inside.
warnings: Pull forward, not up, to avoid damaging the M.2 slot.

evidence.text: After undoing it you have to pull the shroud forward.
The metal cap houses a thermal pad on the on the inside.

steps.title: Locate Wi-Fi card
steps.instruction: Locate the Wi-Fi card close to the cooling fan.

evidence.text: The Wi-Fi card is placed close to the cooling fan.
Finger pointing to small metal Wi-Fi cover near fan

steps.title: Remove Wi-Fi cover
steps.instruction: Undo the screw and slide the small Wi-Fi plate to the left to remove it.
warnings: Slide left gently; do not pull antenna wires.

evidence.text: The removal of the metal cover here is similar to the one of the SSD but this time around you have to slide the small plate to the left
there is also a small cooling pad beneath it

steps.title: Inspect thermal system
steps.instruction: Inspect the fan, single long heat pipe, heatsink and heat spreader.

evidence.text: The thermal system is as as simple as it gets one fan a single long heat pipe one heat sink and a large heat heat spreader
Close-up of fan, long heat pipe and heatsink across board
